description: Update a record by ID. Editing draft fields applies immediately; a `status` change (publish/archive/unpublish) is gated — pass dry_run to preview.

confirm_token.description: Token from a prior dry_run call. Single-use, 7d TTL.

data.description: Replacement field values (validated against the schema).

dry_run.description: For a status change: preview + receive a confirm_token. When omitted, the change applies immediately.

project.description: Optional project — a website inside the workspace (proj_xxx) — to scope this call to. Sent as the X-Project-Id header. If omitted, the spideriq.json / SPIDERIQ_PROJECT_ID binding (or the workspace default project) is used.

workspace.description: Workspace/brand to act on (defaults to your active workspace).

name: collection_record_update
